svg.title: Nutriment and its Impact on Beings

g.text: Nutriment and its Impact on Beings
Leads to purification, end of sorrow, unbinding
Lack of Sense Guarding & No Moderation in Food
Leads to landing and increase of consciousness
Leads to alighting of name-&-form & growth of fabrications
Leads to production of renewed becoming
Leads to stress in present & bad destination
